title: Biodiversity as a Dominant Force in Shaping Ethnic Music Styles生物多样性:塑造民族音乐风格的主导力量
content:
Our findings show that plant, bird, and mammal diversity considerably shape musical features such as vocal range and ornamental sounds, more so than geography or lifestyle. Our study provides the first empirical evidence linking biodiversity to ethnic music styles. Protecting biodiversity, the musical and cultural will be protected.


ABSTRACT

The diversity of plants, birds, and mammals plays a crucial role in shaping the musical styles of ethnic communities. The origin and development of music are nurtured by the natural environment surrounding human societies. To explore how the natural environment influences the musical styles of various ethnic groups, we focused on ethnic minorities in China and their environments. We applied ecological geography approaches to analyze the influence of different ecological and geographical factors on musical characteristics. The results show that neither the living habits of different ethnic groups nor geographical factors are the dominant influences on ethnic music. Instead, the diversity of plants, birds, and mammals plays a key role in shaping the musical styles of these communities. The findings imply that by protecting biodiversity, the musical and cultural heritage of humanity can also be protected.

摘要

植物、鸟类和哺乳动物的多样性在塑造各民族社区的音乐风格中发挥着至关重要的作用。音乐的起源和发展受到人类社会所处自然环境的滋养。为探究自然环境如何影响不同民族的音乐风格, 我们以中国少数民族及其所处环境为研究对象, 运用生态地理学方法, 分析了不同生态和地理因素对音乐特征的影响。结果表明, 不同民族的生活习惯和地理因素均非影响民族音乐的主导因素。相反, 植物、鸟类和哺乳动物的多样性在塑造这些社区的音乐风格中起着关键作用。研究结果提示, 保护生物多样性, 同时也能够保护人类的音乐文化遗产。
